title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: SHAPE Personnel
tiers.description: All directors, all members of the senior leadership team (SLT), and all other employees of SHAPE including contractors, agents, and consultants. Subject to the general insider trading prohibition, the margin lending ban, the short-term/speculative/short-selling restrictions, and the ban on dealing in other companies' securities while holding inside information about them.

tiers.name: Designated Personnel
tiers.description: All directors, all members of the SLT, the Company Secretary, employees involved with preparing SHAPE's financial reports, and any other persons nominated by the Board or Company Secretary. Subject in addition to Prohibited Trading Periods, the derivatives/hedging prohibition, blacklisting, and the written pre-clearance and post-trade confirmation process.

definitions.hedging_definition: a transaction that operates to limit the economic risk of their security holding in SHAPE

windows.end_anchor: commencement of the trading day immediately after the release of the full year results
commencement of the trading day immediately after the release of the half yearly results

windows.end_anchor: commencement of the trading day following the day on which the AGM is held

windows.start_anchor: commencement of the offer period for an offer of Securities or other financial products under a Prospectus (or equivalent document)

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may impose any additional Prohibited Period from time to time, for example when SHAPE is considering matters subject to Listing Rule 3.1A. Confidentiality of such additional periods is not addressed.

rules.detail: Absolute ban, with no clearance route and no security-state qualifier, on Designated Personnel dealing in any financial product issued or created over SHAPE Securities by a third party (e.g. an OTC put or call written by a bank), or dealing in associated products. None of the six Exempt Transactions in section 7 covers this type of dealing.
rules.evidence: Designated Personnel are prohibited from dealing in any financial products issued or created over the Securities by third parties or dealing in associated products.

rules.detail: The section 5.3 derivatives ban applies only to Designated Personnel; it is not extended to other SHAPE Personnel.
Designated Personnel may not enter into any transaction that limits the economic risk of their SHAPE security holding, with no vesting qualifier and no clearance route.
rules.evidence: Designated Personnel ... may not enter into a transaction that operates to limit the economic risk of their security holding in SHAPE.

rules.detail: The hedging prohibition in 5.3 applies only to Designated Personnel.

Monetisation is not named, but a prepaid forward, equity swap or similar structure is a 'financial product issued or created over the Securities by third parties' and so is caught by the same absolute ban that covers derivatives.
rules.evidence: Designated Personnel are prohibited from dealing in any financial products issued or created over the Securities by third parties or dealing in associated products.

rules.detail: Not addressed for personnel who are not Designated Personnel.

Short selling is addressed with softer wording ('should not') than the definitive 'may not' used for short-term/speculative trading in the same section, but appears within the same restrictive clause with no carve-out or clearance route.
rules.evidence: Additionally, SHAPE Personnel should not engage in short selling of the Securities.

rules.detail: Securities lending is not mentioned anywhere in the Policy.
CFDs are not named but are a 'financial product ... created over the Securities by third parties' and so fall within the same absolute ban.
rules.evidence: Designated Personnel are prohibited from dealing in any financial products issued or created over the Securities by third parties or dealing in associated products.

rules.detail: Not addressed for personnel who are not Designated Personnel, though the short-selling and short-term trading rules could catch a CFD in practice.

Blanket ban on margin lending arrangements over Securities for all SHAPE Personnel (a group that includes Designated Personnel), with no approval route and no vesting qualifier, based on the risk that loan terms could force a sale while the person holds inside information.
rules.evidence: SHAPE Personnel are not permitted to enter into margin lending arrangements in relation to the Securities as the terms may require the Securities be sold when the Personnel possesses inside information.

rules.detail: No general prohibition on granting security, a charge, lien or pledge over Securities; only margin lending arrangements are separately named and banned.

Margin lending, the only secured-financing structure the Policy names, is banned outright for all SHAPE Personnel. Other secured financing structures (e.g. a bank loan secured by a pledge that is not styled a 'margin loan') are not separately addressed.
rules.evidence: SHAPE Personnel are not permitted to enter into margin lending arrangements in relation to the Securities as the terms may require the Securities be sold when the Personnel possesses inside information.

rules.detail: Ban on trading in and out of Securities within 3 months, or speculative trading; the Board may, at its discretion, exclude disposal of employee incentive scheme Securities from this restriction, but there is no individual application/clearance process.
rules.evidence: they may not engage in short-term trading (that is, trading in and out of Securities over a period of 3 months or less) or speculative trading in the Securities. The Board may, at its discretion, exclude the disposal by employees of Securities received under SHAPE’s employee incentive schemes from this restriction on short-term trading.

clearance.evidence: All personnel have an individual responsibility to ensure that they comply with the law relating to insider trading and this policy.

clearance.approver: Relevant Officer (Chairperson of the Board, or the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee if the application is from the Chairperson), with notice copied to the Company Secretary
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within 3 days of the dealing occurring
clearance.evidence: No dealing may be undertaken before the Designated Person receives written clearance from the Relevant Officer. If the Designated Person receives written clearance for their proposed dealing, that dealing must be completed within 7 days from the date of the clearance, unless it specifies otherwise.

clearance.approver: Relevant Officer (Chairperson of the Board, or Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee if the applicant is the Chairperson)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: unspecified ('when the approved trading has been completed')
clearance.evidence: SHAPE may, in exceptional circumstances, provide written approval to a Designated Person seeking to trade in the Securities during a Prohibited Period. No exceptional circumstances approval will be provided during the Prohibited Trading Periods set out in section 5.1 of this policy.

short_term.basis: trading in and out of Securities within the period
carve_outs: Board may, at its discretion, exclude disposal of Securities received under SHAPE's employee incentive schemes
short_term.evidence: they may not engage in short-term trading (that is, trading in and out of Securities over a period of 3 months or less) or speculative trading in the Securities.

exceptions.evidence: transfer of the Securities by a Designated Person to a person closely related to the Designated Person (e.g. spouse or family trust) or to their superannuation fund
disposal of the Securities arising from the acceptance of a takeover offer, scheme of arrangement or equal access buy-back
acquisition of the Securities under a pro rata issue
acquisition of the Securities under a security purchase plan or dividend reinvestment plan
acquisition of the Securities under an employee incentive scheme
any other transactions identified by the Board for this purpose

exemption_authority: The Board may, at its discretion, exclude disposal of employee incentive scheme Securities from the short-term trading restriction (4.2), and may identify further Exempt Transactions (7(f)). During a Prohibited Period, the Relevant Officer may give written approval to a Designated Person to trade for exceptional circumstances such as severe financial hardship, except that the Policy also states no exceptional circumstances approval will be given during the specific Prohibited Trading Periods listed in section 5.1 - an internal inconsistency that in practice removes hardship relief while a blackout is actually in effect. No exemption authority exists for the margin lending ban (4.1) or the derivatives/hedging prohibition (5.3).

bespoke_clauses.topic: derivatives/hedging ban absolute for Designated Personnel
bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Personnel are prohibited from dealing in any financial products issued or created over the Securities by third parties or dealing in associated products. In addition, Designated Personnel may not enter into a transaction that operates to limit the economic risk of their security holding in SHAPE.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Both legs of a funded collar - the bank-created put/call and the risk-limiting effect of the structure - are expressly and unconditionally prohibited for Designated Personnel (directors, SLT, Company Secretary, finance-report preparers), and none of the six Exempt Transactions in section 7 applies, so the collar cannot proceed for this tier under the current Policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: SHAPE Personnel are not permitted to enter into margin lending arrangements in relation to the Securities as the terms may require the Securities be sold when the Personnel possesses inside information.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The secured loan leg of a funded collar, if structured as a margin loan, is banned outright for the entire personnel population (not just Designated Personnel) with no exemption route, on stated concerns about forced sale while holding inside information - a concern a bespoke bank facility could try to address contractually but the Policy gives no carve-out for that.

bespoke_clauses.clause: SHAPE may, in exceptional circumstances, provide written approval to a Designated Person seeking to trade in the Securities during a Prohibited Period. No exceptional circumstances approval will be provided during the Prohibited Trading Periods set out in section 5.1 of this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The Policy appears to grant, then immediately withdraw, hardship-based relief for trading during the actual closed windows, so a forced unwind or margin-call-driven sale cannot rely on this exception while a blackout is in effect.

bespoke_clauses.clause: (the Policy does not distinguish unvested from vested Securities anywhere in sections 4 or 5)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Because the derivatives and hedging bans in 5.3 apply to 'their security holding' without qualification, they extend equally to vested shares that would otherwise be freely tradeable, closing off the OTC collar route for Designated Personnel regardless of vesting status.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no clearance regime below Designated Personnel
bespoke_clauses.clause: All personnel have an individual responsibility to ensure that they comply with the law relating to insider trading and this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: For SHAPE Personnel who are not Designated Personnel, there is no notification or preclearance system at all, so a collar over vested shares held by such a person turns only on the margin lending, short-term trading and short-selling prohibitions, with no derivatives-specific bar.

summary: A funded collar is not achievable for Designated Personnel (directors, SLT, Company Secretary and financial-report preparers): section 5.3 imposes an absolute, unconditional ban on dealing in any financial product created over SHAPE Securities by a third party and on any transaction limiting the economic risk of a security holding, with no clearance route, no vesting qualifier, and no applicable Exempt Transaction. The loan leg is separately blocked for all SHAPE Personnel by an outright ban on margin lending arrangements (4.1), motivated by forced-sale risk during inside-information periods, again with no exemption authority. For rank-and-file SHAPE Personnel who are not Designated Personnel, the derivatives/hedging ban does not apply, so an OTC put/call could in principle be entered subject only to the general insider trading prohibition, the 3-month short-term/speculative trading ban, and the short-selling restriction - though the margin lending ban still prevents a margin-loan-style secured facility for this group too. The Policy's hardship exception for Designated Personnel is internally contradictory, expressly withdrawing relief during the very closed windows it purports to cover, so it cannot be relied on to permit collar execution or unwind during a blackout. Overall, the bank's proposed structure is blocked for the director/executive population the offer targets, and only narrowly viable, without the secured loan, for more junior non-Designated personnel.
